50911f7e-75a1-5099-99f1-e471bb8e6cb6.content: One of the user's identity documents needs renewal in the second half of 2025.

d5bd9f79-7295-5014-9668-83b7cffc78e2.content: The user postponed an application until the next day after spending time looking for document photos in scattered folders.

5f92f6a3-1739-580c-bd63-1a936098ccd0.content: After gathering the necessary copies in one folder, the user completed the renewal form in one sitting.

929107ac-c62d-5920-9f71-12d4c9a102e9.content: The user entered an abbreviated name on an official form and then discovered that it differed from the supporting document.

df8b90c2-4310-5e89-b979-508309bf6b04.content: On the next application, after comparing the name with the source document, the user did not receive a correction request.

306b9df1-d713-5413-b448-e2b42376d827.content: The user put only the submission deadline in the calendar and missed the application deadline by one day because they did not check the issuance period.

870b57b5-4cdb-54fc-b17f-8ffb86dad802.content: On the next application, the user recorded the expected issuance date separately in the calendar.

a0fe456c-0794-5bce-8ef9-9558e9833471.content: Staff at a public-service counter expect a person requesting identity verification to bring an original as well as a copy.

111972b9-e05f-5e1b-b121-ef9e51572d1d.content: When planning an official application, put both the submission deadline and expected issuance date in the calendar and verify them.

c9872898-ec4f-576e-b154-ff6fda581a1a.content: The local agent cannot determine the current validity of an identity document without its expiration date.
